objective: Deliver one reproducible Linux/amd64 NVIDIA-capable development image with a safe dashboard default and explicit ROS/Gazebo, GUI, MuJoCo, DDS, and hardware-diagnostic Compose profiles.
acceptance: runtime and Dev Container use the same CUDA 12.8.1 Ubuntu 24.04 digest
default dashboard starts without GPU, GUI, DDS LAN, USB, CAN, or privileged access
ros-sim, X11, Wayland, MuJoCo GPU, and hardware-shell profiles are explicit and fail closed
source is read-only and colcon build/install/log use named volumes
entrypoint sources Jazzy and workbench install then execs the user command
MuJoCo capability smoke is isolated from task, execution, WorldState, and verification contracts
APT/Python/MuJoCo versions, image digest, SBOM, vulnerability scan, and RTX 30/40/50 matrix evidence are recorded
container static tests and CPU dashboard smoke pass; unavailable host capabilities remain NOT_EXECUTED
evidence: CPU dashboard health and read-only smoke output
colcon build/test logs and installed workbench_motion evidence
SBOM, image digest, package manifest, and vulnerability scan report
stop_conditions: a frozen interface, JSON Schema, Pydantic contract, WorldState, replay, or event-log change is required
robot/control or firmware changes are required
host NVIDIA driver, Docker daemon, or real RTX hardware is unavailable for a claimed GPU result
required package or base digest cannot be obtained without silently changing versions
a profile requires privileged, NET_ADMIN, host IPC, xhost +, or automatic hardware motion
a scripted fixture or software renderer would be presented as Gazebo, GPU, or robot evidence
